json_data.title: Web Application Security
json_data.reason: This topic builds on basic cybersecurity principles by focusing on vulnerabilities and defenses specific to web applications, a critical attack vector today.

json_data.title: Security Architecture and Design
json_data.reason: Moving beyond basic defenses, this topic teaches how to systematically design and build secure systems and infrastructures from the ground up, integrating security throughout the lifecycle.

json_data.title: Formal Methods in Security
json_data.reason: This advanced research area explores the use of mathematical logic and rigorous proof techniques to formally verify the correctness and security properties of systems and protocols.
